summary: Polar Power, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 21, 2026, disclosing a securities purchase agreement with LU2 Holdings LLC for up to $500,000 stated value of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock at a purchase price of $450,000 (90% of stated value). The preferred stock bears a 10% annual dividend and converts at 90% of the lowest VWAP over the prior seven trading days, subject to a floor price. Warrants to purchase common stock equal to 50% of stated value divided by exercise price were also issued. The transaction involves a prior $275,000 convertible note from Mayers Ventures LLC. The capital raise is dilutive and structured for investor return, though not a classic buyback. What to watch: conversion mechanics, potential dilution, and stock price floor effects.
